KATSINA STATE (PSI 7.8): Gov Radda Engages Former LG Administrators & Education Secretaries on Sector Reform
BAYELSA STATE (PSI 7.7): Gov Diri Rebuts Coastal Highway Criticism; Defends Swamp Engineering Achievements
EKITI STATE (PSI 7.6): Gov Oyebanji Delivers Final First-Term State Address; Highlights ₦8.8T GDP Horizon
YOBE STATE (PSI 7.5): Yobe Donates 160 Motorcycles to Forest Guard Operations for Environmental Protection
EBONYI (PSI 9.1): Gov Nwifuru commenced installation of a 3MW Independent Power Plant to provide stable 24/7 power to the ICT University community and surrounding Izzi LGA areas.
PLATEAU (PSI 8.9): Plateau expanded its National Social Register from 363k to 1M households across 17 LGAs and approved the Green Industrial Policy (2026–2031) for low-carbon growth.
JIGAWA (PSI 8.8): Gov Namadi partnered with Presidential CNG Initiative to sponsor irrigation pump conversions for farmers, targeting 30 CNG centers by Dec 2026 for wheat production.
DELTA (PSI 8.7): Delta First Lady aided 2,500 women across 25 LGAs with food and ₦50k cash, while Gov Oborevwori fulfilled a ₦50M medical scholarship to student Davina Ogheneovo.
CROSS RIVER (PSI 8.6): Cross River validated 52,330 payroll profiles, restored VIO road operations for vehicle safety while limiting TRAMRA, and backed FCE Obudu's university upgrade.
SOKOTO (PSI 8.5): Gov Aliyu disbursed ₦143M to 76 verified victims of Sokoto Old Market and Motor Park fires, with top grants reaching ₦25M to revive commercial livelihoods.
ABIA (PSI 8.4): Gov Otti approved expanding ThriveAbia tech training to 1,000 youths in Cohort 1 following an 87% pilot graduation rate where over half earned foreign currency.
LAGOS (PSI 8.3): Dep Gov Hamzat advocated tech scaling at TeXcellence citing $22M fiber investments; LASEMA averted explosion by blanketing an overturned 33kL ethanol tanker.
ADAMAWA (PSI 8.2): Dep Gov Farauta opened 3-day ANAN conference on climate accounting, while Works Commissioner inspected 1,000 Housing Estate for internal road expansions.
ONDO (PSI 8.1): Gov Aiyedatiwa ordered extensive fumigation of Igbokoda River following a NAF crash stench, directing water tanker deliveries and health kit distributions.
RIVERS (PSI 8.0): Gov Fubara commended police dedication and female policing pioneers at the book launch of 96-year-old retired DCP Stella Okuyiga alongside IGP Disu.
EDO (PSI 7.9): Edo Tourism Agency received Polish envoys in Benin City, touring historic Igun Street bronze workshops and Thought Pyramid to foster cultural skills exchange.
KATSINA (PSI 7.8): Gov Radda hosted former LG Administrators and Education Secretaries from 34 LGAs to harness institutional public service experience for basic education reform.
BAYELSA (PSI 7.7): Gov Diri faulted Donald Duke's claims on Lagos-Calabar Coastal Highway, citing Bayelsa's successful dual causeways and 630m River Nun bridge across deep swamps.
EKITI (PSI 7.6): Gov Oyebanji delivered his final first-term State Address, highlighting an economy moving toward an ₦8.8T GDP, low food inflation, and SAPZ infrastructure plans.
YOBE (PSI 7.5): Yobe presented 160 motorcycles and equipment to the State Forest Guard to enhance rural environmental surveillance, prevent deforestation, and combat logging.
